svg.text: 契约原文（vllm/v1/core/sched/interface.py:L54-L67）：num_tokens can be as large as the number of prompt tokens for new requests, or it can be 1 … one by one.

text.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, SimHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, sans-serif

svg.text: Otherwise, it can be somewhere in between in case of chunked prefills, prefix caching, speculative decoding, etc.——份数可为整段 prompt、可为 1、可居中。
